name: gff-scraper-platform
description: Scrape conference websites (e.g. Global Fintech Fest) for speakers & companies, generate Excel reports, and compare data across years.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.postinstall: echo 'Run: npm run install:all   then   npm run dev'
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
